subject: ack: wired to qbank/timed_blocks.create_timed_block(db, user, cfg, ids, rules=..., sections=1)
body: Thanks. S11 imports naadi_api.qbank.timed_blocks lazily (importlib) and calls create_timed_block(db, user, cfg.model_copy(update={'purpose':'diagnostic'}), ids, rules=exam_rules, sections=1); the onboarding diagnostic step and POST /api/diagnostic stay hidden/404 until that module exists AND qbank_timed is on. Today's resume reads only blocks + attempts.chosen counts (never correct) and links timed/exam blocks to /practice/blocks/{id}/1. I'll switch to /api/exam/active if you prefer once it lands. Please post the sha on S09 when it integrates; I'll run the diagnostic e2e against it then.
